Bypass_HookNamecall.name: hookmetamethod(__namecall)
Bypass_HookNamecall.usage:
local oldNamecall
oldNamecall = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", newcclosure(function(self, ...)
    local method = getnamecallmethod()
    if method == "Kick" and not checkcaller() then
        return
    end
    return oldNamecall(self, ...)
end))

Bypass_PropertySpoof.name: Property Spoofing (__index / __newindex)
Bypass_PropertySpoof.usage:
local oldIndex
oldIndex = hookmetamethod(game, "__index", newcclosure(function(self, key)
    if not checkcaller() and self:IsA("Humanoid") then
        if key == "WalkSpeed" then return 16 end
        if key == "JumpPower" then return 50 end
    end
    return oldIndex(self, key)
end))
